action.name: Compress to ZIP
action.command: sh -c 'cd "$1" || exit; shift; if [ $# -eq 1 ]; then b="${1%%/}"; else b=Archive; fi; n="$b.zip"; i=2; while [ -e "$n" ]; do n="$b-$i.zip"; i=$((i+1)); done; zip -rq "$n" "$@" || notify-send -u critical "Zip failed" "$n"' sh %d %N

action.name: Extract Here
action.command: sh -c 'for f; do p="${f%%/*}"; t=$(mktemp -d "$p/.unzip-XXXXXX") || continue; if ! unzip -q "$f" -d "$t"; then rm -rf "$t"; notify-send -u critical "Unzip failed" "$f"; continue; fi; if [ "$(ls -A "$t" | wc -l)" -eq 1 ]; then e=$(ls -A "$t"); s="$t/$e"; b="$p/$e"; else s="$t"; b="${f%%.*}"; fi; n="$b"; i=2; while [ -e "$n" ]; do n="$b-$i"; i=$((i+1)); done; mv "$s" "$n"; if [ -d "$t" ]; then rmdir "$t"; fi; done' sh %F
action.description: Extract .zip into a folder named after it

action.name: Open in VS Code
action.description: Open folder in Visual Studio Code
